skill.summary: One-click AI product video generator for Chinese e-commerce, upgraded with advanced creation modes. Use it for classic one-click product videos, single-image...

latestVersion.changelog:
qstar-video-ecom v1.3.1

- Improved image upload handling: now detects if the upload endpoint is unavailable (e.g., returns 404) and falls back to passing public image URLs directly to the generation backend.
- Clarified that uploaded images must be accessible by the backend (not internal or inaccessible URLs).
- Updated instructions to avoid retrying unavailable upload endpoints and to ensure public image URLs are used when necessary.
- Minor wording and behavior clarifications to ensure user expectations match backend capabilities.
